act4/encounters/fight_morvayn.title: Confrontation with Morvayn
act4/encounters/fight_morvayn.body: **Morvayn** raises his staff. The dice decide.

choices.text: First phase — confrontation!
First phase — confrontation!

act4/encounters/fight_morvayn_2.title: Throne Awakening
act4/encounters/fight_morvayn_2.body: The throne **awakens**. Its form fills out with borrowed bones.

choices.text: Second phase — throne!
Second phase — throne!

act4/encounters/pact_vigil_skirmish.title: Vigil Skirmish
act4/encounters/pact_vigil_skirmish.body:
From the **shadow** of a fountain, a **Vigil** archer cuts your path. He comes without sermon — he comes with **certainty**.

"**Servant** is not citizen", he says. "It is an open **wound** in the city."

choices.text: Answer the Vigil's steel

onEnterDiaryTexts: A Vigil hunter recognized my step — not my face. The pact smells of betrayal to those who swear by the light.

act4/late_merchant.title: Throne Merchant
act4/late_merchant.body:
Between **chains** that bind nothing, someone **unfolds** a cloth — vials that **tremble** as if they still had **patience**.

The merchant **measures** you: he smells like someone who **fears** climbing without having cut the shadow at the root.

The voice does not come from the **throat**; it comes from the **echo** that already knows your name.

> Stock **limited**. The throne **eats** memory, but **gold** pays for silence.

choices.text: Buy Red Potion (14 gold) (x2)
Buy Red Potion (14 gold) (x1)
Buy Blue Tonic (18 gold) (x1)
Buy Mead (12 gold) (x1)
Vigil field kit (−7 gold)
choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Step away from the merchant

act4/morvayn_interlude.title: False Truce
act4/morvayn_interlude.body:
Morvayn **wavers** — not from weakness, from **theater**. The throne **breathes** through him, and you feel the air turn **contagious** like cathedral sickness.

You have an **instant** to decide *how* you carry the next assault: in the **head**, in the **bone**, or in **blind haste**.

choices.text: Make one last sweep of the hall
Bury the fear in your mind (+Mind, 3 scenes)
diaryTexts: Before the second phase, I sealed the echo like invisible armor and read the hall with calm.

choices.text: Harden the body (+STR, 3 scenes)
diaryTexts: The throne trembles — so do I, but by choice. Each step measures the next blow.

choices.text: Accept the seal's cost and breathe deep (−Mind, +cruel focus)
diaryTexts: Instead of running, I accepted the tremor. Clarity came with pain.

choices.text: Force the second phase now (shortcut without exploring)

act4/morvayn_parley.title: Parley with Morvayn
act4/morvayn_parley.body: "Peace is **silence**", Morvayn says. "Choose the silence you prefer to hear."

choices.text: Refuse the pact and fight
Accept service to the Third Bell
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Morvayn; victory leads to pact, failure to combat.
choices.lockedHint: The Third Bell only extends its hand to those the Cult has not yet marked as declared enemies.

choices.text: Try to seal the dungeon (sacrifice)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 2 measures of faith to risk the seal — conviction drawn tight.

act4/pact/pact_after_mind.title: Domesticated Echo
act4/pact/pact_after_mind.body:
The echo **settles**. It does not vanish — it learns your name and goes quiet out of courtesy.

For an instant, you feel the world like a well-oiled **machine**: every wheel turning because you **allow** it.

choices.text: Cross the square without faltering

act4/pact/pact_after_mind_fail.title: Echo's Bite
act4/pact/pact_after_mind_fail.body:
The echo **bites**. A spark crosses your thoughts like **steel** on tongue.

You still serve — but you feel the price as sweet **nausea**, like poison honey stuck to the roof of your mouth.

choices.text: Cross anyway — by force

onEnterDiaryTexts: The echo ran down my throat. A tooth broke in my attention — and the Third Bell laughed softly.

act4/pact/pact_ascent.title: Pact Ascent
act4/pact/pact_ascent.body:
The **dungeon** falls behind you like a damp cocoon — **silence** stuck to skin. The air above smells of old rain and cheap incense — but beneath the skin, something **pulls** downward, always, as if the world had learned a new rhythm to obey.

A **bell** does not ring. Even so, your pulse tries to follow what does not exist.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I accepted the Third Bell. Each step upward sounds like a peal only I hear.
act4/pact/pact_ascent.skillCheckLabel: Contain the Third Bell before the surface

act4/pact/pact_ascent_fail.title: Fractured Echo
act4/pact/pact_ascent_fail.body:
The **Third Bell** strikes inside like a hammer on glass.

For an instant, you climb with another body's knees, breath short and mind in
sparks. The street opens before you — and Morvayn is already waiting, as if your failure
had been the invitation.

choices.text: Fail in silence and face Morvayn

onEnterDiaryTexts: I lost the Third Bell's measure. I climbed broken, and Morvayn heard the crack.

act4/pact/pact_coda.title: Pact Coda
act4/pact/pact_coda.body:
The hunter falls or flees; the city **learns** to pretend asleep.

You serve the **Third Bell** as **conduit** — beat without tower, because the tower **learned** through you. The **ring** on your finger: **mute** to others, deafening to you.

Cold rises into the city's skin; day arrives **obedient** — and you hear the promised fourth stroke, never fused.

choices.text: Accept what was written in you

onEnterDiaryTexts: I served the Third Bell. The ring on my finger does not ring — but the world learned to go quiet when I breathe.

act4/pact/pact_trial_mind.title: Trial of Mind
act4/pact/pact_trial_mind.body:
Market noise **folds** over itself. You see symbols where there is nothing — or there always was, and only now can you **read**.

To keep from **splitting** in two, you need one thing only: hold your head as the **chamber** of sound, not as the bell.
act4/pact/pact_trial_mind.skillCheckLabel: Sustain the Third Bell's echo in your mind

act4/pact/pact_whispers.title: Pact Whispers
act4/pact/pact_whispers.body:
Between **watchmen** who pretend not to see and merchants who look away, a voice — not yours — describes what you will do before you think it.

**"Serve."** Not a request. A **measure**.

The Third Bell needs no metal: it needs **someone** to carry the echo without breaking.

choices.text: Let the whisper finish

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the city, windows close early. Silence is not peace — it is a queue.

act4/passage_graywind_heights.title: Passage

choices.text: Stop at the threshold — gray armor that did not come from the throne
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

choices.text: Set out for Graywind Heights — follow the ice rumor
choices.preview: Chapter 5. Far from the throne, the cold still asks who rules silence.

act4/seal_ending.title: Seal Ending
act4/seal_ending.body:
You seal the **Silent Dungeon** at a price. Scars on the soul; fragile peace in the stones.

The seal asks more than blood: two **beats** in succession — first the **mind** holding the bell bursting inside, then the **body** not yielding when weight
falls on the bones like stone.
act4/seal_ending.dualAttrSkillCheckLabel: Two beats of the seal — mind and iron

act4/seal_ending_fail.title: Peace Ruptured
act4/seal_ending_fail.body:
Peace **fails** for an instant that is enough.

The stones tremble, the seal opens a crack, and you take in the chest the scar of what you could
not contain.

Morvayn smiles like someone who already knew: now the fight begins with the world against you.

choices.text: The seal breaks. Fight Morvayn

act4/throne/throne_arcane.title: Runes Beneath the Green Pulse
act4/throne/throne_arcane.body: The runes do **not glow** — they **throb**. If you look away, they rearrange like **fingers** on a throat.
act4/throne/throne_arcane.skillCheckLabel: Read the pattern without letting the throne in

act4/throne/throne_arcane_fail.title: Letter That Bites
act4/throne/throne_arcane_fail.body: The line **splits** you in two: not lack of intelligence — too much **invitation**. The throne laughs **without sound**, and you feel the echo like sacred **heartburn**.

choices.text: Drop your gaze and return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: The rune bit my thought — a hole remained where order should be.

act4/throne/throne_arcane_ok.title: Pattern Contained
act4/throne/throne_arcane_ok.body: For an instant, the symbol **fits**: not power — **grammar**. The throne stops being only fear and becomes a **sentence** you can refuse aloud.

choices.text: Keep the mental map and return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: I saw the throne's measure — not enough to tame it, enough not to lose myself at once.

act4/throne/throne_chains.title: Living Chains
act4/throne/throne_chains.body:
The chains **want** fingers. They do not bind only the throne — they **rehearse** your name like someone testing a new chain.

Between them, trapped in black resin: a **finger** with a broken bell ring and marks of human teeth — not beast — as if someone had **bitten** the hand that swore before the Vigil scraped the oath from stone.

choices.text: Take a fragment caught in the metal (−1 supply, +2 gold)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to force the fragment free without breaking yourself.
diaryTexts: I tore a shard from the throne's bone — the metal did not forgive, but the pocket thanked me.

choices.text: Let the drip touch your skin (+1 corruption, −1 faith)
choices.lockedHint: Without faith to spend, the drip finds no coin in you — accumulate at least 1.
diaryTexts: I tasted the drip: sweet as promise, and promise always charges interest.

choices.text: Pull your hands back and return

act4/throne/throne_class_blessing.title: Craft in the Hall
act4/throne/throne_class_blessing.body: The hall **recognizes** crafts as it recognizes **tools**: it does not judge — it **measures** what you can ruin with them.

choices.text: Trace a brief sign in the air — contained blessing
diaryTexts: The throne does not accept light — but accepts that I name it without offering it for free.

choices.text: Measure the space with your body — wall posture
diaryTexts: The floor asked for weight; I gave discipline, not theater.

choices.text: Count the echo as incomplete formula
diaryTexts: Every silence has a coefficient — I only wrote down what does not eat me first.

choices.text: Return without invoking craft

act4/throne/throne_gate.title: Throne Antechamber
act4/throne/throne_gate.body:
The **Bone Throne** rises in interlaced ribs; **chains** groan without wind.

**Morvayn** precedes the chair — **shadow**, then a smile with **no certain lips**. The green pulse **beats** with your heart; the hall returns **foreign whispers** that know your name.

Each **rehearsal** in the hall **spends** itself on bone: you can still **bargain** with the merchant or let steel **wait**.

choices.text: Hear the necromancer before crossing steel
choices.preview: Words before steel; pact or provocation.

choices.text: Attack at once (without words)
choices.preview: Steel now — or hesitation that becomes talk.

choices.text: Observe the throne: bones, runes, chains
choices.preview: Information and risk of being seen too much.

choices.text: Bargain with the merchant in the chains' shadow
choices.preview: Gold, items, and silence in vials.

choices.text: Arcane inspection — read runes without yielding to the throne
choices.preview: Mind against rune; failure may cost.

choices.text: Nerve trial — the floor that lies
choices.preview: Luck and steady leg; the floor deceives.

choices.text: Probe chains and drip
choices.preview: Chains and suspect liquid; gold or curse.

choices.text: Craft in the hall: blessing, posture, or formula
choices.preview: Your class opens one ritual path.

act4/throne/throne_nerves.title: Nerve Trial
act4/throne/throne_nerves.body: The floor **invents** steps. If you hesitate, the bone underfoot **records** your weight as debt.
act4/throne/throne_nerves.luckCheckLabel: Keep your hands steady when the floor lies

act4/throne/throne_nerves_fail.title: Stumble
act4/throne/throne_nerves_fail.body: Your sole **slips** on thick memory. You do not fall — but you **pay** the fright with breath and sweat.

choices.text: Accept the fright and return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: I stumbled where there was nothing — the throne likes to pretend holes.

act4/throne/throne_nerves_ok.title: Steadfastness
act4/throne/throne_nerves_ok.body: Your body **believes** in you for once. Not heroism — minimum **contract** with the floor.

choices.text: Return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: Fear came — and passed without stealing my name.

act4/throne/throne_observe.title: The Throne
act4/throne/throne_observe.body:
Each bone of the throne has **one name** scraped away — you cannot read them all. One of them is your **first fear** in small letters.

The chains **drip** something thick. It is not blood. It is **memory** too dense to run. If you look too long, the throne **learns** the shape of your fear — and that does not erase with prayer.

choices.text: Try to read one full name (Mind test)
Intercept the chains' drip (luck)
Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_luck.title: Chain Drip
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck.body: The drop **lingers** in the air like a decision. If you miss the timing, you do not wet your hand — you **wet** fate.
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck.luckCheckLabel: Catch a drop without being marked

act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_fail.title: Betrayed Drop
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_fail.body: The drop **falls** where it should not — **stains** your sleeve, steals warmth, laughs **without teeth**.

choices.text: Shake your hand and keep observing
Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_ok.title: Captured Drop
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_ok.body: At the right instant, **memory** mistakes you for its owner. Use it: the throne has not noticed yet.

choices.text: Keep observing the throne
diaryTexts: The drop solidified between my fingers — small coin of ice and luck.

choices.text: Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_mind.title: Scraped Names
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind.body: The names **murmur** when you should not be listening. If you read aloud, the bone **answers** with yours.
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind.skillCheckLabel: Decipher a name without the throne hearing

act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_fail.title: Trapped Letter
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_fail.body: The letter **escapes** and leaves a **buzz** where sense should be. The throne likes **holes** — you just paid for one.

choices.text: Give up the reading and keep observing
Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_ok.title: Silence Read
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_ok.body: You find a **line** that does not belong to you — and still **aligns** your fear like a ruler.

choices.text: Keep observing the throne
diaryTexts: One name yielded — not mine, but one that serves as crooked mirror.

choices.text: Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_sweep.title: Last Sweep
act4/throne/throne_sweep.body: Before the throne **closes** the account, you can treat the hall like a **table** — measurements, wagers, **honest** mistakes.

choices.text: Follow a fissure behind the throne (explore in silence)
Catalog bones and shadows (Mind test)
Release a forbidden syllable into the void (luck)
Give the bone no more time — to the second phase

act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_fail.title: Count That Flees
act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_fail.body: The bone **multiplies** when you are not looking — not trick, **cruel pedagogy**.

choices.text: To the second phase — throne!

onEnterDiaryTexts: I lost the count and the throne added a line to my fear.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_ok.title: Bone Map
act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_ok.body: The number **closes** a circle: you are no longer visitor — you are **measure** inside the room.

choices.text: To the second phase — throne!
diaryTexts: I counted until the hall grew small — space is a lie when you know where you step.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_catalog.title: Merciless Inventory
act4/throne/throne_sweep_catalog.body: Each rib is an **argument**. If you convince yourself too much, the throne **adds** another line beside you.
act4/throne/throne_sweep_catalog.skillCheckLabel: Count bones without losing yourself in the number

act4/throne/throne_sweep_hidden_treasure.title: Treasure Buried in Bone
act4/throne/throne_sweep_hidden_treasure.body:
Between petrified ribs, you find a **black nodule** caught in old iron. When you touch it, the hall shifts weight; something in you learns a new rhythm.

It is not gold. It is a **fragment of will** torn from the throne.

choices.text: Keep the fragment and return to the hall

onEnterDiaryTexts: In a hidden cut of the throne, I found a living fragment: it throbs like sharpened memory.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_word.title: Syllable in the Void
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word.body: There are words the air **refuses**. If you time it right, silence pays; if you fail, the hall **charges** interest.
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word.luckCheckLabel: Release the word without being overheard

act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_fail.title: Word That Bites
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_fail.body: The void **does not forgive** badly calibrated audacity. You pay with **body** and purse.

choices.text: To the second phase — throne!

onEnterDiaryTexts: The word returned like a whip — it stole breath and provisions.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_ok.title: Subtracted Echo
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_ok.body: For an instant, the hall **forgets** you. That is all you need: not to be the throne's **matter**.

choices.text: To the second phase — throne!
diaryTexts: The syllable fell like coin — the void accepted payment.

act4/victory_peace.title: Victory in Silence
act4/victory_peace.body:
The **snap** beneath the crown sounds like **closure**, not coronation: a door yielding when there is no longer **anyone** pushing from the other side.

The green pulse **melts** into silence; the throne, for an instant **furniture**, then **stone** again. **Victory**, **lean**: you remained standing.

choices.text: Gather what remains — listen to the throne
